name: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited
summary: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited, together with its subsidiaries, publishes and prints books, newspapers, magazines, and commercial prints in South Africa. It operates through Publishing, Printing and Distribution; and Packaging and Stationery segments. The company engages in publishing and printing of newspapers and magazines, digital assets, labels, web and gravure printing, and book printing; property owning; and television channel development business. It also provides digital and telecommunication solutions. In addition, the company manufactures and distributes packaging, stationery, and labels.
